beats: My son can't read yet, so his tasks are pictures and letters — no words, on purpose.
But one card still blinked a question mark, with no way to know what to do without me right there.
So each card now writes its own instruction — one line in Norwegian, one in Ukrainian.
A parent or older sibling reads it aloud; he still can't read a single word himself.
Every card, letter, number, or handwriting — now speaks in two languages.
